definitions.gloss: frontispiece; title page illustration; opening illustration
definitions.explanation: An illustration on or facing the title page of a book, or the opening illustration of a chapter or section in a manga, magazine, or publication.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{扉絵|とびらえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{綺麗|きれい}だ。
examples.english: The opening illustration of this manga is really beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{扉絵|とびらえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}いた→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: A famous painter drew the frontispiece.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週刊|しゅうかん}→週刊：14373_shuukan⟧⟦{連載|れんさい}→連載：14320_rensai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎回|まいかい}→毎回：13202_maikai⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧{扉絵|とびらえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{添|そ}えられて→添える：13315_soeru⟧おり、⟦{単行本|たんこうぼん}→単行本：11937_tankoubon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{収録|しゅうろく}→収録：08378_shuuroku⟧⟦されない→する：00392_suru⟧もの⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The weekly serialized manga has a different opening illustration each time, and some are not included in the collected volumes.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{扉|とびら}→扉：04494_tobira⟧ (door; title page) and ⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧ (picture). In publishing, ⟦{扉|とびら}→扉：04494_tobira⟧ refers to the title page, so {扉絵|とびらえ} is literally the picture on the title/opening page.

USAGE:
Very common in manga fandom, where each chapter's opening page illustration is called a {扉絵|とびらえ}. These are often specially drawn and may contain hidden details or foreshadowing. In book publishing, it refers to the frontispiece — a decorative or thematic illustration at the beginning of a volume.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {扉絵|とびらえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|か}く→描く：28436_kaku⟧: to draw a frontispiece / opening illustration
- ⟦{連載|れんさい}→連載：14320_rensai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{扉絵|とびらえ}: the opening illustration of a serialized work
- {扉絵|とびらえ}⟦コレクション→コレクション：07327_korekushon⟧: collection of title illustrations
- ⟦カラー→カラー：10820_karaa⟧{扉絵|とびらえ}: color opening page

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{挿絵|さしえ}→挿絵：12818_sashie⟧: illustration (inserted in text) — drawings placed within the body of the text, not specifically at the opening
- ⟦{表紙|ひょうし}→表紙：04351_hyoushi⟧: cover — the outer cover of a book or magazine, distinct from the interior title page
- {口絵|くちえ}: frontispiece (of a book) — a near-synonym, though {口絵|くちえ} is used more in traditional publishing while {扉絵|とびらえ} is also common in manga
